english: I'll play with Sadomaru No. 25 a little longer.
Sougo... Remembered something urgent... Rest is up to you...
D-don't be stupid! N-not scared of ghosts...
Y-yeah... Since we're here, I'll let Kondo have the honor...
Huh?! Oh, no... Toshi can handle it.
Then it's that. A ghost, for sure.
Then why not talk to it?
Hijikata should do it. The Demon Vice-Chief can't be scared of anything!
Don't need one? You flew here?
No time for jokes... So, what do we do?
Say I lend you my body... What happens to me?
How do you gather life energy?
Find someone and talk to them, right?
No choice... You'll die if we leave you like this, right?
And talk to a woman who isn't pretty, instant game over...
Of course you're light. No body.
No body? Then no corpse when you die.
Planning to steal OUR life energy?!
We have to look. If it dies like this, what happens to Toshi...?
Then why can't you go home?
Could you stop calling everything plasma?
An alien with no body. Just a mind.
Actually, I'm in trouble. Could you help?
Came to this planet, but now I can't get home...
No, didn't come in a spaceship. Don't need one.
With no body, physics doesn't affect me. I can cross space and time.
Give me a break. Don't treat me like an invader.
So, a favor. Could you lend me your body?
I'll get inside and gather life energy.
Nothing happens to you. Nothing changes.
Just talk to someone. I'll automatically absorb their life energy.
I'll only take a safe amount. It's fine.\fThey probably won't even notice.
Only a little per person... Ten people, I suppose.
You can only talk to beautiful women. No one else will do.
No means no. Talk to a woman who isn't beautiful, and I die.
All right, then? Going in! Combine!
Can't take any more life energy from her. Better not talk.
Does this count as a conversation...?
Hijikata's the one with something to say.
What DID they come here for...?
Looking for beauties. Got a moment...?
That's enough. Must've absorbed her life energy.
Just making it look that way.
Don't believe me? Fine. I'll fight alone.
Seems Otsu qualifies as a beauty.
Then hurry up and find the next one.
Then you picked the right girl! Necromancer!
It's hard sometimes, but hearing the fans cheer makes it all worthwhile.
Princess Soyo...! What brings you here?
Life in the castle sounds hard.
Oh, dear... Must get back at once.
Not flirting. Just want to talk.
Sounds like you've been fooled a lot.
All men say that to fool women.
Should've absorbed life energy from that conversation.
Running around helping people... Feels that way...
Let's go... Should've absorbed her life energy now.
I do not mind, but why do such a thing?
How admirable.\fSomeone once helped me too.
What might Lord Mayora 13 be doing now...?
Not just pretty. A dangerous beauty in glasses.
But I'm even prettier without my glasses. Look.
No! Don't mistake me for that idiot!
Bland or not, still a beauty. Counts as a pass.
So that's why you spoke to me?
Then where am I among the ten?
Otae's on the list too, right?
Rankings matter! The girls at my club have sales rankings too!\fEspecially Otae. Can't lose to her!
Next time, request me and order Dom Perignon, okay?
Yeah... Must've absorbed her life energy.
We're not picking a top ten.
No need to linger any longer.
No! Help us. Think of it as saving someone.
To save one life... No, two, including mine! Please talk to me.
That's it?! That wasn't a conversation!
Oh, big dogs or little ones? Which...
We exchanged words, so it should be fine, right?
It's fine. If not, Hijikata just dies. That's all.
No! No time to explain, but this is to help someone.
Have to talk to ten beauties. Help me out.
No... That's not what I meant...
Yeah. Must've absorbed her life energy.
Already talked. Should be enough, right?
You just look like a pervert.
If I can help, I will, but...
If you want beauties, there's Otae and Ane. Better than me.
Personality aside, she passes, doesn't she?
Hijikata's not dead, so she's a beauty.
